thread:
Mira: Quick sync — we've got the raw interview with Novapulse. Need to ship 3 snackable clips (30s each) and a long-form case video by next Wed (embargo Fri 05/12).
Jake: Got it. Which moments are priority?
Mira: 1) product fit quote ("Redwood cut inference cost by 60%") 2) latency anecdote 3) developer DX soundbite.
Sam: I'll pull timestamps and create rough cut list today.
Jake: Can you drop the timestamps in this thread when you have them? I'll prep the edit timeline.
Sam: Rough timestamps: 00:45-01:12 (cost quote), 04:10-04:40 (latency), 06:05-06:35 (DX).
Mira: Perfect. Also need localization: Spanish & German subs. Liz — can you handle translation handoff?
Liz: Yep. I need the SRT for each clip and the interview transcript. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Ana: Legal — quick note: the customer requested a minor name redaction in the 30s clip if we mention partner X. We'll need signed asset release before embargo.
Mira: Do we have the release?
Jake: We have the interview consent, but not the final asset release. Reached out to account team.
Mira: Can you @account-team please?
Jake: @account-team — can you send the signed release for Novapulse? Need before Wed.
Account-Team-Bot: (automated) Assigned to rep_kira — Kira has been pinged.
Kira: On it. Forwarding signed release now.
Kira: Sent PDF to #shared-assets > /marketing/releases/novapulse_release_signed.pdf
Ana: Received. Reviewing redaction request — looks fine. One small legal redline on wording "cut inference cost" — recommend "reduced inference cost by ~60%".
Mira: Good catch. Sam — once you render drafts, swap "cut" -> "reduced" where needed and flag clip 1 for legal review.
Sam: Will do. Jake — timelines: rough cuts by tomorrow noon?
Jake: Yep. I'll upload to Wistia and link here.
Jake: Uploaded rough cuts: https://wistia.com/medias/novapulse-snackables-draft
Liz: Downloading for translation.
Ana: I'll sign off on wording after seeing rough cut.
Mira: Also routing — we should create a short launch post + benchmark blurb. Who can draft?
Sam: I can write the post draft. Will include a micro-benchmark table: tokens/sec, cost per 1k tokens, latency p50/p95. Need numbers from eng.
Mira: @eng-data or @bench-bot?
Bench-Bot: micro-bench results for novapulse-config: tokens/sec: 4200, cost/1k tokens: $0.18, p50 latency: 120ms, p95: 310ms.
Sam: Great, I'll format that into a small table.
Mira: Final checklist: [ ] Rough cuts uploaded, [ ] Legal sign-off, [ ] Signed release, [ ] Localized SRTs, [ ] Launch post draft, [ ] Wistia embeds & CTA links, [ ] Social calendar slot.
Jake: I'll check boxes as done.
Kira: Release uploaded and shared with customer for final OK. They approved minor wording change.
Ana: Legal sign-off complete — redaction done, wording adjusted.
Liz: Spanish/German SRTs uploaded to /marketing/localization/novapulse/{es,de}/novapulse_clips.srt
Sam: Draft launch post in Google Doc: https://docs.google.com/.../novapulse-launch-draft — comments welcome.
Mira: Awesome. Let's aim to schedule Social + Blog for Fri 05/12 09:00 PT.
Jake: Will export final masters and Wistia embeds by Thursday EOD.
Mira: Thanks team :tada:
